messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error rate 18% over last 5m, saturation on model-runner pool. Pager: oncall@redwood. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/incidents/runtime-5xx

mike-oncall: I'm on it. switching to incident channel. gathering initial scope — @cory-sre can you pull recent runner logs and kvcache metrics?

cory-sre: pulling logs now. seeing repeated SIGSEGV from model_runner process on nodes inf-uk-03/inf-uk-07 but also present in us-west-2. stack trace looks like: 
```
#0 0x7f8a3c4b in kv_cache::read() at model_runner.cc:842
#1 0x7f8a3f2d in attention::compute() at attention_kernel.cc:214
#2 0x7f8a1a8c in run_inference() at entrypoint.cc:131
```
coredumps being written to /var/crash/model_runner.*

cory-sre: memory graph shows outbound memory growth on the kvcache map until OOM then SIGSEGV, looks like a corruption loop.

jenna-eng: repro attempt on staging with same model variant (redwood/gptx-12b-quant-v2). after ~120s of streaming it hits a segfault with identical trace. adding ASAN run now.

mike-oncall: customer impact — @sara-support do we have list of customers seeing errors? any high-severity SLA exposures?

sara-support: Support telemetry: ~22 customers with increased 502/504s, top impacted: acme-inc (10% of their calls), beta-ai (8%), shoply (5%). No active P0 pages yet but errors are user-visible for streaming sessions (timeouts and truncated replies). Preparing draft status update for status.redwood.com

alan-research: hypothesis: quant attention kernel path regression after last runtime patch (kernel selector change). Can we revert kernel selection to legacy for affected model families?

jenna-eng: I can push a quick rollback of kernel-selector flag on the canary model pool. patch: `KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy-attention` on runner config. will push to 10% of traffic first.

mike-oncall: do it. Also enable fallback routing to stable model variant (gptx-12b-float32-v1) while we validate. Ops, please create traffic rule to route 30% of new sessions to stable variant.

ops-bot: Routing rule created: route/unstable->stable gptx-12b 30% in us-west-2. CLI: `infra route create --from unstable --to stable --pct 30 --region us-west-2`

cory-sre: after toggling kernel selector on the canary pool, saw drop in segfaults on those nodes. rolling the flag to the rest of pool now. OOMs still observed on older nodes with kvcache growth. draining inf-uk-03 and repro nodes to force restart and clear corrupted cache.

mike-oncall: good. jenna, after rollback + fallback routing, any residual 5xx rates?

jenna-eng: within 10 minutes 5xx down from 18% to ~4% in canary region. global error rate dropped to 7% after routing. staging ASAN shows memory leak in kvcache->eviction path; creating PR to add stronger validation and guard.

alan-research: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/model-runner/pull/482 (adds kvcache bounds checks and safe-evict). recommending backport to current release as hotfix.

mike-oncall: action items:
- (jenna) backport and hotfix patch, coordinate with SRE for canary deploy (ETA 45m)
- (cory) resume draining/restarts for affected nodes and monitor coredumps, preserve one core for debugging
- (sara) publish status update: incident detected, mitigation in place, partial recovery, investigating root cause
- (ops) continue traffic routing to stable until hotfix verified

sara-support: status update posted to status.redwood.com: "Degraded performance for text generation endpoints in multiple regions. Partial mitigation in place: traffic routed to stable model variants, investigating runtime crashes. No confirmed data loss. Engineers are working on a hotfix."

cory-sre: preserving cores and logs: uploaded /var/crash/model_runner.* to s3://incidents/1850004321/cores.tar.gz. also collected `dmesg` and `journalctl -u model-runner`.

jenna-eng: hotfix built and running on canary (tag: model-runner-hotfix-185000). monitoring CPU/memory and segfaults. so far 30m green on canary.

mike-oncall: if canary holds for 60m, plan for progressive rollout. keep fallback routing live until global error rate <1% for 30m.

alan-research: logging note: add extra kvcache debug event around eviction to help post-mortem. will add to PR.

mike-oncall: good work team. keep updates here. once stabilized we'll prepare RCA and timeline for customer communications. :thumbsup:

jenna-eng: update 30m later: canary stable, rolling hotfix to remaining pools now (staged by region). no new SIGSEGVs observed post-patch.

cory-sre: last check: global 5xx at 0.9%. inf-uk nodes drained and restarted; monitoring for recurrence. marking incident as mitigated in channel but keeping thread open for RCA notes.

sara-support: customer follow-up: outreach to top impacted customers drafted, offering post-incident report and SLA credit if thresholds breached.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated - Reduced 5xx to <1%. Auto-attach: https://incidents.internal/1850004321/summary

mike-oncall: closing in 2h unless new regressions. RCA next steps: gather core analysis, PR diff, timeline, and postmortem doc.
